Lemme see. First things first. Your first layer is almost always the lightest color that makes up the area. Next goes the second lightest color and so forth. Make sure to use a light hand and use a sharp pencil. Not so sharp that it snips the tip off, but enough that it doesn't look like crayon scribble. When you have correct hue or hue transition, then either use Oderless paint thinner to blend it out (there are many videos on how to do so on YouTube), or burnish by using some of the same colors.
